message: スパイ

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking about this the other day, after we found Ardin and saved Azel from that tight spot, but」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mean when the Demons ran away, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think our patrol routes have a lot of blind spots?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now that you mention it... I don't remember ever patrolling around there」

name: Misa
message: 「I noticed that ages ago, though!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then say something. That's lame, Hisa」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm. Synn, you said the Demons didn't seem like they wanted to fight, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. They didn't seem like they were running away out of fear, either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It felt more like they'd been ordered to run if they ran into us」

name: Ria
message: 「They're choosing places where they're unlikely to run into us. And if they do, they flee... Is that what's going on?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could they be predicting our movement patterns?」

name: Misa
message: 「No way」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, the situation is far more serious. This is definitely the work of a spy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That Waitress is stealing information about us!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Doesn't really ring a bell」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't think she's that sharp, anyway」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, she doesn't have any connection to us」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ding! I've figured out who the spy is!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yoo-hoo! I came to hang out~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The spy is Ms. Omake!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whaaat?! Me, a spy?! An intellectual worker?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's even less likely」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. At most, she'd just sneak into our stash of snacks」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph. Hey, you're treating me like I'm a dummy!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it. It means we trust you」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, I get it! Everyone except angels is a good guy!」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan. You shouldn't call someone a spy without any proof, no-no」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Droop~*」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's check it out on-site!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh. I don't usually go this way」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite the airhead too, Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't want to hear that from you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. There were actually a lot of spots we hadn't patrolled」
Nanaka checks off spots on the park map she is holding in her hand.

name: Ria
message: 「We've been overlooking places where the paths are narrow or dark from overhanging tree branches, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, almost all of the dead-end paths」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But going down paths that are dark even at this hour late at night is dangerous」

name: Paqy
message: 「We patrol 'em *because* they're dangerous, don't we?」

name: Azel
message: 「Danger should be avoided」

name: Sally
message: 「You guys are all dummies! Just fly. You can see way better from up high」

name: Synn
message: 「Because we can't fly」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, Lolotte-san, it wouldn't be much of a patrol if we avoided the dark paths」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I suppose it wouldn't be a problem for you, Vice President, since you've abandoned your maidenhood」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't just let that remark slide!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After all, it's 'A Maiden in Love is ★ Heart-Pounding! Throbbing Summer Vacation'」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That was, um」

name: Azel
message: 「If you haven't thrown it away, don't walk the streets at night」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't want to hear that from you, Azel-san, wandering around after school hours without even having patrol duty!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, Misa-chan. Azel-chan is just worried about everyone's safety, and Lolotte-chan didn't mean any harm」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. Senpai-san understands very well. I'm simply being honest」

name: Misa
message: 「That makes it even worse!」

name: Azel
message: 「Still, it's a fact that the danger has increased」

name: Synn
message: 「Which is all the more reason we have to patrol」

name: Ria
message: 「But if the area we have to patrol expands, we won't have enough hands」

name: Azel
message: 「What can't be done can't be done. Don't push yourself」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, Sally-chan! Won't you help us out?」

name: Sally
message: 「Could that be intellectual labor? Am I intellectual?」

name: Azel
message: 「No. Idiotic」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp. I feel like you just said something really awful」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's you, Sally-chan, you can do it」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez really gets me! Leave the intellectual labor to me!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll try asking Boss too!」

name: Azel
message: 「You're letting a Demon General into the academy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's already one here anyway」

name: Azel
message: 「And that's what happened」

name: Pasta
message: 「Sigh... What a pain, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「Even based on my information, the encounter rate will likely go up」

name: Pasta
message: 「Still, no matter what, Eauderourke surely won't participate, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「He will」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaaaaah! He should just stick to eating, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「If demons capable of flight join in, the odds of being spotted go up. Be careful.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Could it be you're worried about me, nya?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'll tell everyone to run if they run into the Student Council, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Did you see Lord Virus and Pervert Ardin fight, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「The gap in strength was too wide. It was foolish.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Still... I kinda get it, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「Get what?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Everyone turns into an idiot when they fall in love, nya... Though that guy was an idiot to begin with, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「Have you ever been in love, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's pointless.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Whether it's pointless or not doesn't matter, nya. When it happens, it just happens, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「That's only because they've let their guard down.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Before you even realize it, your eyes end up following just that one person, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't have anyone like that!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Why are you getting all worked up, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up.」
